tool_args.rationale: The pilot supports a concave sink-inhibited base field, while the added measurements show a pronounced high-gradient collapse. Fit a thresholded avalanche correction jointly with the archived siphon base and use fresh confirmation to test whether it generalizes.

considered_alternatives.option: Smooth two-layer siphon without a threshold
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The high-gradient observations reverse sharply and become negative, unlike the pilot's smooth saturation.
The observed discrepancy is in the sink-gradient regime, not an identified temporal ambiguity; the targeted high-gradient probe has already been acquired.

considered_alternatives.option: Cooperative Hill inhibition or barrier-modulated siphon
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These smooth archived mechanisms do not directly account for the abrupt high-gradient collapse; fresh confirmation will test the threshold hypothesis.
